thread:
maria: quick follow-up on allocator hints for offload. proposing a tiny opt-in surface: companion_tag (string), frag_tolerance (0..1), prefer_host_backing (bool), soft_reserve_bytes (int). runtime interns tag -> tag_id stored at slab granularity.
devon: slab-level tags sound good to avoid per-block overhead. how do we handle callers w/o tags?
maria: default to '__untagged'. optional fingerprinting behind feature flag for experiments only. prod stays deterministic.
liam: rollout idea: enable on canaries, 48h metrics window, auto-disable per-tenant if p50 latency regresses >5%.
anya: telemetry to add: companion.vram_bytes, companion.host_staging_bytes, companion.fragmentation_ratio, companion.evictions_per_min. I'll add dashboards and alert thresholds.
devon: compaction policy: prefer within-tag compaction; only do cross-tag compaction during low load or above fragmentation threshold.
maria: eviction ranking should factor frag_tolerance so tolerant companions are preferred eviction sources.
liam: ops request: let us map multiple logical tags into one physical bucket (mergeable-tags) for A/B experiments.
infra-bot: noted: canary flag name `allocator.companion_tags.enable`. infra will coordinate rollout and add an observability ticket.
maria: action list: RFC PR with API sketch, devon proto intern-table, anya dashboards, liam canary SLO rule.
